tagline: Leading fertility and family building benefits management platform
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of covered members represents the extent of the market served and the company's revenue potential. With 6.7 million members in 2025, PGNY captures a growing share of its addressable market of 106 million potential covered lives.

kpis.name: Member Base
kpis.explanation: Number of covered lives enrolled in PGNY's solutions
kpis.description: PGNY's member base increased by 217,000 members (3.4%) to reach 6.7 million covered lives as of December 31, 2025, compared to 6.5 million as of December 31, 2024.

kpis.name: Number of Clients
kpis.explanation: Number of organizational clients that have subscribed to PGNY's solutions
kpis.description: PGNY's number of clients increased by 82 clients (17.3%) to reach 555 clients as of December 31, 2025, compared to 473 clients as of December 31, 2024.

kpis.name: Assisted Reproductive Technology Treatment Cycles
kpis.explanation: Number of ART cycles (including IVF, embryo freezing and egg freezing) performed for PGNY members
kpis.description: The total number of ART cycles performed for the full year 2025 increased by 3,892 cycles (6.4%) to reach 65,006 cycles, compared to 61,114 cycles in 2024.

kpis.name: Overall Member Utilization Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of all members (male and female) who used fertility and family planning services during the period
kpis.description: The overall utilization rate for the year 2025 was 1.32%, slightly up from 1.31% in 2024, reflecting stable utilization of fertility benefits among the member base.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt for the last 4 years.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance for the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 0.74 Bns € last year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance for the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.03 Bns € last year

kpis.name: Cash and Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents extracted from yfinance for the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash and equivalents of 0.11 Bns € last year

kpis.name: Client Sector Diversification
kpis.explanation: Number of different industries represented in PGNY's client portfolio
kpis.description: PGNY has diversified its client base across more than 40 different industries, compared to only 2 industries at launch of its fertility benefits solution in 2016.

kpis.name: Addressable Market Penetration Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of potential covered lives represented by PGNY's current member base
kpis.description: PGNY's current 6.7 million members represent approximately 6.3% of the total addressable market estimated at 106 million potential covered lives among employers with more than 1,000 employees, Taft-Hartley populations and federal populations.

risks.title: Dependence on usage-based revenue model
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned as a key component of the business model in the 10-K, with strong language on dependence on treatment utilization. Revenue stability is directly tied to utilization rates, which are low (1.32% in 2025). The Capital category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Loss of a major key client
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions the non-renewal of a major client and the impact of a transition agreement. The language indicates significant risk to the client base. This risk is new compared to the prior year.

risks.title: Dependence on a few large clients
risks.score_rationale: While not explicitly stated in terms of concentration, the loss of a major client is highlighted, suggesting concentration risk. The language is indirect but the potential impact is high, particularly with the mention of members excluded from utilization.

risks.title: Growing competition in the fertility benefits market
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited in the context of acquiring new clients. The language is moderate, but the context shows increased pressure. Competition is a key growth factor, so weighted accordingly.

risks.title: Dependence on specialized provider networks
risks.score_rationale: Contracts with clinics and pharmacies are short-term (1-2 years), creating disruption risk. The document highlights the importance of the network, but without alarming language. Industrial category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Risky expansion into new health solutions
risks.score_rationale: New offerings (pregnancy, menopause, etc.) are described as strategic investments but not yet profitable. The language indicates risk of adoption failure or low return on investment.

risks.title: Risk of service cost management
risks.score_rationale: Cost of services includes variable elements (drugs, providers) and rising labor costs. The document notes continued growth in care team costs. Factual language but high impact intensity on margin.

ai_positioning.summary: PGNY does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
